notes.title: Flying High Summer Sale, Chinese Update
notes.notes:
Flying High now available at a 25% discount as part of steam summer sale! Great time to add Flying High to your precious visual novel game collection. Check out the demo if you want to try before you buy.

All Chinese dialogue has been updated with a professional translation and we've tweaked the Japanese language option as well. If you've already purchased the game, check for the automatic update.

所有中文对话都已经由专业翻译进行了更新。如果您已经购买了游戏，请检查自动更新。

We're also working on adding a new animation of the floating bj scene to the game. Here are a couple preview shots.

notes.title: Flying High Demo release
notes.notes:
As announced in our previous post, we are happy to bring to you the Flying High Demo. The demo of Flying High contains around 25% of the game (including 2 of the 10 animations) and allows you to see for yourself what the game plays like and whether it's for you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963461/94eff85b0c36066276fead72ad9aba5c1b9e5805.jpg

As a reminder, here's a table that describes what the game is and isn't. We've added this prominently to the description as well. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963461/5ffa5d53b7311d2df95cd486be50e8c8454e60a3.jpg

Go ahead and play the demo and I hope you enjoy it :)

notes.title: Flying High Steam release imminent!
notes.notes:
It's happening! We're launching Flying High tomorrow!!! And we couldn't be more excited! So excited in fact, we're discharging Flying High with a launch special! To make sure you have every excuse to treat yourself to Solar and Eclipse's story of intense unification… but... you'll need to wishlist Flying High on Steam to get notified as soon as the launch special arrives! So go ahead and wishlist Flying High now (if you haven't already).

While we wait just a few more hours we'll leave you with some more previews of course =)

notes.title: Flying High Steam release is a go!
notes.notes:
Just a quick announcement. We’re excited to confirm that

Flying High has been green lit for release on steam for May 10th, 2024 (Fri)

as well as the Affect3D store release  on May 11th, 2024 (Sat).

Be sure to wishlist Flying High on steam.

We are currently in the process of testing different language versions including French; Spanish; Hungarian; German; Dutch; Japanese and Czech. Also, regarding Controllers, we have done an initial test and everything seems to work smoothly!

notes.title: Flying High Release coming very soon!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the upcoming release of Flying High in just a few short weeks. We've just recently updated the release with an initial set of steam achievements that will hopefully entice exploring the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963461/1dc8e000adbfcd7837dfae319fb868c78e3c87de.jpg

One thing we're still working on is localizing the game for the following languages: English, Spanish, French, German and Japanese. We're also open to translating the game for most other languages. If you're interested in helping us translate the game for a free copy of the game and/ or other perks send us a dm or email steam@affect3d.com for more info.

I'll leave you with a couple shots of the big guy sneaking up on Solar, but being the pro superhero she is, she'll make short work of the horny monster no doubt!
